# Expected contract

- The skill must not require a docs layout, tracker, roadmap, Milestone, or another local skill.
- It reads `work/export-audit.md` and relevant repository contracts before splitting work.
- It drafts narrow complete tasks with Acceptance, ownership surfaces, shared contracts, blocking edges, and local verification.
- It audits coverage, ownership overlap, contract compatibility, mergeability, and integration proof.
- It asks the user to confirm the task graph before publishing durable task artifacts.
- Approval authorizes the task map and handoffs only; the skill stops before implementation.
